topics.name: Governance Decision and Explainability Monitor
topics.purpose: Define a read-only/candidate-edit Expose monitor for governance decisions, explanations, conflicts, reviews/appeals and policy-change candidates.

semantics.readonly_rule: Monitor is read-only by default; policy edits remain candidate-only.
semantics.identity_rule: Governance decision, AccessCore decision, policy, explanation, review and candidate revision identities remain distinct.
semantics.action_rule: review/appeal/edit-policy/validate/apply operations use separate authorized workflows.
semantics.authority_rule: Viewing explanation grants no protected-resource authority.
semantics.privacy_rule: Explanations avoid leaking denied protected values.

invariants.rule: Policy, decision, evidence, audit record, consent, incident and compliance result remain separate machine-significant identities; no evidence artifact silently becomes source data, authorization or runtime authority.

Ambiguous or unresolved governance for protected data fails closed; UI visibility, transport reachability, cache presence, role title, prior access or audit-log presence never substitute for an explicit valid policy decision.

hard_gates.condition: monitor treats governance allow as AccessCore allow
